about: Harness Zero against the field: the lean Harness Zero candidate against Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes and QM on Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol over the second v0.3 dev draw, plus gbrain and MCP-instruction cells: per-cell tables, comparisons against each model's lean baseline, and the preregistered verdicts.

not_rebuilt.reason: It is a grep for gstack and Capy paths over each shard's full trial tree as copied back from its VM, harness state and workspaces included, plus a search of two container images; those trees and images were never committed.
It was built from each trial's Harness Zero session files (state/zero/sessions/*.json), which stay out of the repository with the rest of harness state, and no script in the repository writes it.

volatile.reason: The commit id of the statistics code. The public copy has its own commit ids, so this changes between copies; the statistics code itself is checked by the rebuilt numbers.
